raw: {"tool":"plan-draft","args":{"inbox_id":"gh-1188-7289048fa2a6","authored":{"scope":["Verify the current foreman, driver heartbeat, Jog lease reconciliation, and hosted attention mechanisms before designing the liveness signals.","Design a local last-run record and best-effort remote visibility with an independent hosted dead-man's switch.","Design single-host lease reconciliation using corroborated heartbeat, process, and lease evidence; leave cross-host TTL leases to a separately gated issue."],"acceptance":["The design keeps heartbeats separate from wake-up, progress, and completion decisions; completion requires a receipt and reviewer attestation.","The local last-run record precedes the best-effort remote update, and reporting failures do not alter the pass exit code.","A stale or mismatched heartbeat produces uncertainty and corroborated reconciliation that parks work without automatic refire.","The design identifies how the hosted check detects missed runs and uses the existing attention pattern."],"open_questions":["What acceptance criteria appear beyond the truncated issue body?","How should stale heartbeat evidence be corroborated with process and lease state before parking, especially when the process still exists?","Which current foreman and hosted attention mechanisms are available, and what wake interval and alert threshold should apply?"]}},"reason":"This is the oldest eligible actionable request; its material supports a design-only draft and leaves implementation details to verification.","confidence":0.97}
